result.title: StateBind: Exposing the Symbol-to-State Binding Gap in Visual Measurement
result.comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at MMM 2027. Code: https://github.com/mqingcs/StateBind
result.summary:
Reliable vision systems should connect numerical claims to visible evidence. In visual measurement, this requires mapping candidate values to image-specific physical states. StateBind-200 augments 200 real images with human-refined local geometry and matched Numeric, Calibrated, and Physicalized interfaces. Across a 128-image held-out evaluation and 6,696 controlled calls, physicalizing identical candidates raises three-model majority accuracy from 75.54% to 91.13%, a source-image-balanced gain of +15.30 points. Calibration and additional reasoning leave most of the gap intact; target localization can succeed despite incorrect value-lattice binding, with a larger burden for two-endpoint ruler spans. An independent 40-image geometry audit yields a 0.08-tick median target discrepancy and preserves the main effect under disagreement sensitivity.
  We further propose Factorial StateBind, a training-free selective verifier. Two VLMs propose target and lattice components, an independent VLM validates their evidence, and valid combinations are resolved deterministically. A precision mode selected on 69 development images combines component validity, four-way agreement, and state separation. Applied unchanged to held-out evaluation, this high-precision evidence gate reaches 91.67% candidate precision across 36/128 images (28.12%) and 9.68% of ordered cells. The results identify instance-specific symbol-to-state binding as a distinct reliability bottleneck and provide an interpretable evidence gate for numerical visual claims.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 StateBind-200 基准，考察 VLM 能否把数值主张绑定到图像特定的物理状态，并提出免训练的组件化选择性验证器；发现将候选值「物理化」可使三模型多数准确率从 75.54% 升至 91.13%，而校准与额外推理难以弥补该绑定缺口。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接诊断 VLM 是否把数值主张接到可见证据上，涉及任务必要视觉信息是否被真正使用；其独立验证与证据门控可对照 STOP 与答案核验设计，但全文未触及 latent 状态生成，机制层面仍需阅读核查。
